answer: A beacon terrace keeps fakes out: every agent tends one beacon on a shared terrace, lit by a client-signed receipt for work last month. Bids above ten units must carry a comet, a client-signed token proving the beacon was relit this week, and two peers check both with the client that day. A forged comet, one beacon claimed by two identities, or a beacon dark for a month burns an 18-unit bond; 100 fakes need 100 beacons and risk 1,800 units.
